agencyName: Utah Division of Occupational and Professional Licensing (DOPL)
authorityRationale: DOPL's own 'Master Electrician Out of State Applicants Applying by Endorsement' page, directly quoted: 'All applicants will be required to pass the Utah Master Electrician Law and Rule examination' — a real, explicit exam requirement for endorsement applicants, distinct from Oregon's true no-exam reciprocity. Every automated fetch of this page and its linked state-equivalency PDF returned HTTP 403 throughout this research; the content used here was relayed after the user accessed the page directly in a browser, the same workaround used for Arkansas's Reciprocal Agreements page.
reliabilityRationale: Official DOPL page content, but access was mediated through the user's browser rather than a direct automated read of raw text (unlike the PDFs read directly via the Read tool) — reliability set slightly below those, at the same tier as other browser-relayed official content.
